versos.hebraico: אַֽל־תִּ֭תְהַלֵּל בְּי֣וֹם מָחָ֑ר כִּ֤י לֹא־תֵ֝דַ֗ע מַה־יֵּ֥לֶד יֽוֹם׃

controles.web: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.
controles.kjv: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
controles.livre: Não te orgulhes do dia de amanhã; porque não sabes o que o dia trará.

versos.hebraico: יְהַלֶּלְךָ֣ זָ֣ר וְלֹא־פִ֑יךָ נָ֝כְרִ֗י וְאַל־שְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.
controles.kjv: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.
controles.livre: Que o estranho te louve, e não tua própria boca; o estrangeiro, e não teus próprios lábios.

versos.hebraico: כֹּֽבֶד־אֶ֭בֶן וְנֵ֣טֶל הַח֑וֹל וְכַ֥עַס אֱ֝וִ֗יל כָּבֵ֥ד מִשְּׁנֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.
controles.kjv: A stone is heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool’s wrath is heavier than them both.
controles.livre: A pedra é pesada, e a areia tem seu peso; mas a provocação do tolo é mais pesada do que estas ambas.

versos.hebraico: אַכְזְרִיּ֣וּת חֵ֭מָה וְשֶׁ֣טֶף אָ֑ף וּמִ֥י יַ֝עֲמֹד לִפְנֵ֥י קִנְאָֽה׃

controles.web: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?
controles.kjv: Wrath is cruel, and anger is outrageous; but who is able to stand before envy?
controles.livre: O furor é cruel, e a ira impetuosa; mas quem resistirá firme perante à inveja?

versos.hebraico: ט֭וֹבָה תּוֹכַ֣חַת מְגֻלָּ֑ה מֵֽאַהֲבָ֥ה מְסֻתָּֽרֶת׃

controles.web: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.
controles.kjv: Open rebuke is better than secret love.
controles.livre: Melhor é a repreensão clara do que o amor escondido.

versos.hebraico: נֶ֭אֱמָנִים פִּצְעֵ֣י אוֹהֵ֑ב וְ֝נַעְתָּר֗וֹת נְשִׁיק֥וֹת שׂוֹנֵֽא׃

controles.web: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.
controles.kjv: Faithful are the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
controles.livre: Fiéis são as feridas feitas por um amigo, mas os beijos de um inimigo são enganosos.

versos.hebraico: נֶ֣פֶשׁ שְׂ֭בֵעָה תָּב֣וּס נֹ֑פֶת וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ רְ֝עֵבָ֗ה כָּל־מַ֥ר מָתֽוֹק׃

controles.web: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.
controles.kjv: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
controles.livre: A alma saciada rejeita  o favo de mel; mas para a alma faminta, toda coisa amarga é doce.

versos.hebraico: כְּ֭צִפּוֹר נוֹדֶ֣דֶת מִן־קִנָּ֑הּ כֵּֽן־אִ֝֗ישׁ נוֹדֵ֥ד מִמְּקוֹמֽוֹ׃

controles.web: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.
controles.kjv: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so is a man that wandereth from his place.
controles.livre: Como a ave, que vagueia de seu ninho, assim é o homem que anda vagueando de seu lugar.

versos.hebraico: שֶׁ֣מֶן וּ֭קְטֹרֶת יְשַׂמַּֽח־לֵ֑ב וּמֶ֥תֶק רֵ֝עֵ֗הוּ מֵֽעֲצַת־נָֽפֶשׁ׃

controles.web: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.
controles.kjv: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so doth the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.
controles.livre: O óleo e o perfume alegram ao coração; assim é a doçura de um amigo com um conselho sincero.

versos.hebraico: רֵֽעֲךָ֨ ורעה אָבִ֡יךָ אַֽל־תַּעֲזֹ֗ב וּבֵ֥ית אָחִ֗יךָ אַל־תָּ֭בוֹא בְּי֣וֹם אֵידֶ֑ךָ ט֥וֹב שָׁכֵ֥ן קָ֝ר֗וֹב מֵאָ֥ח רָחֽוֹק׃

controles.web: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster: better is a neighbor who is near than a distant brother.
controles.kjv: Thine own friend, and thy father’s friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother’s house in the day of thy calamity: for better is a neighbour that is near than a brother far off.
controles.livre: Não abandones o teu amigo, nem o amigo de teu pai; nem entres na casa de teu irmão no dia de tua adversidade; melhor é o vizinho que está perto do que o irmão que está longe.

versos.hebraico: חֲכַ֣ם בְּ֭נִי וְשַׂמַּ֣ח לִבִּ֑י וְאָשִׁ֖יבָה חֹרְפִ֣י דָבָֽר׃

controles.web: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.
controles.kjv: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.
controles.livre: Sê sábio, meu filho, e alegra meu coração; para que eu tenha algo a responder para aquele que me desprezar.

versos.hebraico: עָר֤וּם רָאָ֣ה רָעָ֣ה נִסְתָּ֑ר פְּ֝תָאיִ֗ם עָבְר֥וּ נֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ׃

controles.web: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
controles.kjv: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself; but the simple pass on, and are punished.
controles.livre: O prudente vê o mal, e se esconde; mas os ingênuos passam adiante, e sofrem as consequências.

versos.hebraico: קַח־בִּ֭גְדוֹ כִּי־עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וּבְעַ֖ד נָכְרִיָּ֣ה חַבְלֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!
controles.kjv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
controles.livre: Toma a roupa daquele que fica por fiador de estranho; toma penhor daquele que fica por fiador da estranha.

versos.hebraico: מְבָ֘רֵ֤ךְ רֵעֵ֨הוּ׀ בְּק֣וֹל גָּ֭דוֹל בַּבֹּ֣קֶר הַשְׁכֵּ֑ים קְ֝לָלָ֗ה תֵּחָ֥שֶׁב לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.
controles.kjv: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.
controles.livre: Aquele que bendiz ao seu amigo em alta voz durante a madrugada lhe será considerado como maldição.

versos.hebraico: דֶּ֣לֶף ט֭וֹרֵד בְּי֣וֹם סַגְרִ֑יר וְאֵ֥שֶׁת מדונים נִשְׁתָּוָֽה׃

controles.web: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:
controles.kjv: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.
controles.livre: A mulher briguenta é semelhante a uma goteira contínua em tempo de grande chuva;

versos.hebraico: צֹפְנֶ֥יהָ צָֽפַן־ר֑וּחַ וְשֶׁ֖מֶן יְמִינ֣וֹ יִקְרָֽא׃

controles.web: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.
controles.kjv: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, which bewrayeth itself.
controles.livre: Tentar contê-la é como tentar conter o vento, ou impedir que o óleo escorra de sua mão direita.

versos.hebraico: בַּרְזֶ֣ל בְּבַרְזֶ֣ל יָ֑חַד וְ֝אִ֗ישׁ יַ֣חַד פְּנֵֽי־רֵעֵֽהוּ׃

controles.web: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.
controles.kjv: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
controles.livre: O ferro é afiado com ferro; assim também o homem afia o rosto de seu amigo.

versos.hebraico: נֹצֵ֣ר תְּ֭אֵנָה יֹאכַ֣ל פִּרְיָ֑הּ וְשֹׁמֵ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣יו יְכֻבָּֽד׃

controles.web: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.
controles.kjv: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.
controles.livre: Aquele que guarda a figueira comerá de seu fruto; e o que dá atenção ao seu senhor será honrado.

versos.hebraico: כַּ֭מַּיִם הַפָּנִ֣ים לַפָּנִ֑ים כֵּ֤ן לֵֽב־הָ֝אָדָ֗ם לָאָדָֽם׃

controles.web: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.
controles.kjv: As in water face answereth to face, so the heart of man to man.
controles.livre: Assim como a água reflete o rosto, assim também o coração reflete o ser humano.

versos.hebraico: שְׁא֣וֹל ואבדה לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּ֑עְנָה וְעֵינֵ֥י הָ֝אָדָ֗ם לֹ֣א תִשְׂבַּֽעְנָה׃

controles.web: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.
controles.kjv: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.
controles.livre: O mundo dos mortos e a destruição nunca estão fartos; assim também os olhos do homem nunca estão satisfeitos.

versos.hebraico: מַצְרֵ֣ף לַ֭כֶּסֶף וְכ֣וּר לַזָּהָ֑ב וְ֝אִ֗ישׁ לְפִ֣י מַהֲלָלֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.
controles.kjv: As the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so is a man to his praise.
controles.livre: Como o crisol é para a prata, e o forno para o ouro, assim o homem é provado pelos louvores que lhe dizem.

versos.hebraico: אִ֥ם תִּכְתּֽוֹשׁ־אֶת־הָאֱוִ֨יל׀ בַּֽמַּכְתֵּ֡שׁ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָ֭רִיפוֹת בַּֽעֱלִ֑י לֹא־תָס֥וּר מֵ֝עָלָ֗יו אִוַּלְתּֽוֹ׃פ

controles.web: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.
controles.kjv: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, yet will not his foolishness depart from him.
controles.livre: Ainda que esmagues ao tolo em um pilão junto com os grãos, ainda assim sua loucura não se separaria dele.

versos.hebraico: יָדֹ֣עַ תֵּ֭דַע פְּנֵ֣י צֹאנֶ֑ךָ שִׁ֥ית לִ֝בְּךָ֗ לַעֲדָרִֽים׃

controles.web: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds:
controles.kjv: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, and look well to thy herds.
controles.livre: Procura conhecer a condição de tuas ovelhas; põe teu coração sobre o gado;

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י לֹ֣א לְעוֹלָ֣ם חֹ֑סֶן וְאִם־נֵ֝֗זֶר לְד֣וֹר דור׃

controles.web: for riches are not forever, nor does even the crown endure to all generations.
controles.kjv: For riches are not for ever: and doth the crown endure to every generation?
controles.livre: porque o tesouro não dura para sempre; nem uma coroa dura de geração em geração.

versos.hebraico: גָּלָ֣ה חָ֭צִיר וְנִרְאָה־דֶ֑שֶׁא וְ֝נֶאֶסְפ֗וּ עִשְּׂב֥וֹת הָרִֽים׃

controles.web: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.
controles.kjv: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.
controles.livre: Quando a erva aparecer, e surgirem a folhagem, e se juntarem as ervas dos montes,

versos.hebraico: כְּבָשִׂ֥ים לִלְבוּשֶׁ֑ךָ וּמְחִ֥יר שָׂ֝דֶ֗ה עַתּוּדִֽים׃

controles.web: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.
controles.kjv: The lambs are for thy clothing, and the goats are the price of the field.
controles.livre: Os cordeiros serão para tuas roupas, e os bodes para o preço do campo;

versos.hebraico: וְדֵ֤י׀ חֲלֵ֬ב עִזִּ֗ים לְֽ֭לַחְמְךָ לְלֶ֣חֶם בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וְ֝חַיִּ֗ים לְנַעֲרוֹתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt have goats’ milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and for the maintenance for thy maidens.
controles.livre: E o leite das cabras será o suficiente para tua alimentação, para a alimentação de tua casa, e para o sustento de tuas servas.
